bullets: On Monday 12 October, DLD recorded 757 sales worth AED 2.1bn, which is 2.7 percent above a typical weekday.
Off-plan properties made up 66.8 percent of sales, compared to a 7-day average of 62.5 percent.
The median price was AED 1,680 per square foot, up 2.0 percent over 30 days and down 0.4 percent year-on-year.
Over the last 7 days, the busiest areas were JVC with 195 sales, Dubai South (DWC) with 165 sales, and Majan with 132 sales.
In September new rental contracts for JVC 1-bedroom apartments had a median of AED 69,000 a year, rising 3.2 percent on the month.
talking_points: Dubai has unveiled massive infrastructure and housing pipelines, including a $572bn pipeline and a $55bn infrastructure push, which directly impact real estate sentiment and neighborhood desirability.
The ICP has launched a free online tool to check Golden Visa eligibility, and Dubai has detailed four groups eligible for Golden Visas, directly clarifying residency rules for property buyers.
Ready home prices in the last 90 days have risen by 18.8 percent in Palm Jumeirah and 10.1 percent in Downtown Dubai.
